profile.headline: AI Research Engineer Sr. at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: With over 5 years of combined experience in manufacturing and software engineering at Lockheed Martin, I am currently advancing my expertise through graduate research at Stanford University. At Lockheed Martin, I have led the development of software solutions that enhance system performance and reliability. My experience spans technologies such as FastAPI, Docker, and GitLab CI/CD, with a focus on delivering scalable, adaptable, and secure solutions. Throughout my career, I’ve cultivated leadership skills and a strong problem-solving mindset in high-impact, mission-critical environments. I am passionate about applying AI to both industry and research settings, with interests in aerospace systems, graphics, healthcare models, and education models. I thrive in collaborative environments where innovation and critical thinking are key to delivering success.
